basic_details.scholarship_name: Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC & SJTU Fellowship)
basic_details.offering_entity: China Scholarship Council (CSC - Ministry of Education of China) & Shanghai Jiao Tong University
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Shanghai Jiao Tong University Minhang & Xuhui Campuses (Shanghai, China)
basic_details.major_restrictions: School of Electronic Information and Electrical Engineering (SEIEE): Computer Science and Engineering, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Science and Technology, Information and Communication Engineering, and Control Science.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~200 to 300 Chinese Government Scholarships and SJTU Fellowships awarded across graduate cohorts annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Very high bilateral representation under China-Pakistan higher education partnerships; Pakistani graduate scholars secure ~25 to 40 fully funded awards annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2.5 to 3 years for Master of Science; 3 to 4 years for Doctor of Philosophy, subject to passing annual CSC scholarship review
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: RMB 3,000 / month for Master's (~PKR 115,000 / month); RMB 3,500 / month for PhD (~PKR 135,000 / month)

nationality_requirements: Non-Chinese citizens in good health holding valid foreign passports (Pakistan fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Master's applicants must be under 35 years of age; PhD applicants must be under 40 years of age.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) with minimum CGPA 3.30 / 4.00 (or 75%+ marks) from an HEC-recognized university in Pakistan for Master's; recognized MS/MPhil (18 years education) with strong thesis output for PhD.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum grade equivalent of Grade B+ or 75% marks across academic transcript.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Rigorous undergraduate preparation in algorithms, computer architectures, linear algebra, discrete mathematics, and programming (C/C++, Python).
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduating seniors in their final semester can apply conditionally with expected graduation transcripts.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior software development, open-source projects, or published research papers in IEEE/ACM venues significantly strengthen candidacy.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.0, TOEFL iBT minimum 85, or institutional English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from Pakistani university.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Chinese language proficiency (HSK) is not required for English-taught graduate programs.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants must contact a prospective supervisor at SJTU SEIEE and secure a formal or informal Acceptance Letter prior to formal application.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another Chinese government or provincial scholarship simultaneously.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee exemption at Shanghai Jiao Tong University covered for the entire program duration.

admission_application_fee.details: SJTU international graduate application fee of RMB 800 (~USD 115 / ~PKR 32,000) payable online.

accommodation.details: Free accommodation in on-campus international student dormitories (single or twin room) at Minhang Campus, or monthly housing subsidy of RMB 700 - 1,000 if living off-campus.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly tax-free living allowance: RMB 3,000 per month for Master's students (~PKR 115,000 / month; RMB 36,000 / year); RMB 3,500 per month for PhD scholars (~PKR 135,000 / month; RMB 42,000 / year).

airfare.details: International travel expenses must be arranged by the student; living allowance easily accommodates local savings.

visa_fee.details: Chinese X1 Student Visa application fee (~PKR 15,000) at the Chinese Embassy in Islamabad or Consulate in Karachi.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive Medical Insurance for International Students in China (Ping An Insurance ~RMB 800 / year) provided 100% free by the CSC.

food_allowance.details: Covered via the monthly living stipend of RMB 3,000 - 3,500; heavily subsidized campus canteens provide complete halal meals for RMB 10 - 20 per meal.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to SJTU Central Library, laboratory workstations, GPU clusters, and software development platforms.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Laboratory funding available through supervisor's National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC) grants for presenting research at conferences.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to RMB 5,000 for conference travel

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free campus shuttle bus operating across Minhang Campus and between Minhang and Xuhui Campuses.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single elite C9 League university: Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU).
participating_institutions: Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Minhang & Xuhui Campuses, Shanghai, China)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Member of China's prestigious C9 League (China's Ivy League); ranked #51 globally in QS World University Rankings, #27 globally in Computer Science and Information Systems.
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 2.5 to 3 years for Master's; 3 to 4 years for PhD
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's degree with strong academic record (CGPA >= 3.3/4.0), professor acceptance letter, study plan (1,000 words), two recommendation letters, and certified English proficiency.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: SJTU SEIEE Computer Science and AI labs are among the most competitive in Asia; securing an acceptance letter from a professor between October and December is the single most critical factor for scholarship nomination.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Pakistani applicants should browse SEIEE faculty profiles (seiee.sjtu.edu.cn), email prospective supervisors with a concise research proposal and CV, and obtain the official SJTU Provisional Acceptance Letter before the December 15 early deadline.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: SJTU International Student Portal & CSC Online Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register an account on the SJTU international admissions portal (isc.sjtu.edu.my), select degree program, check the box applying for Chinese Government Scholarship / SJTU Fellowship, and apply on the CSC portal (Agency No: 10248).
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Identify prospective supervisors in SJTU SEIEE and secure the official SJTU Acceptance Letter (October - December).
Step 2: Create user credentials on the SJTU International Student Admissions Portal (https://isc.sjtu.edu.cn/).
Step 3: Submit online degree application, upload all required documents, and check the box applying for CSC / SJTU Fellowship.
Step 4: Pay the application fee of RMB 800 before the deadline (typically December 15 for Round 1 / February 15 for Round 2).
Step 5: Apply on the CSC portal (https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/) under Type B using SJTU Agency Number 10248.
Step 6: SEIEE faculty committee reviews files, conducts online technical interviews, and nominates candidates to CSC in March.
Step 7: Official admission and scholarship package (JW201 form) dispatched in June/July; apply for Chinese X1 visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Track: Single application via the SJTU portal covers both program admission and scholarship nomination.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via automated links dispatched directly to their official institutional email addresses.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Study and research plan (minimum 1,000 words in English) outlining academic background, proposed research focus, and reasons for choosing SJTU.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured 3 to 5-page research proposal detailing background, problem formulation, methodology, and expected timeline.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed academic CV highlighting technical projects, publications, programming proficiencies, and awards.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 20 to 30-minute technical video interview via Zoom / Tencent Meeting conducted by faculty admissions panel.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (min 6.0), TOEFL iBT (min 85), or institutional English MOI certificate accepted; GRE not required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degrees and transcripts attested by HEC and MOFA Pakistan; Matric/Inter by IBCC.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English or Chinese translation required for all official documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online upload via SJTU admissions portal and CSC portal.

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested copies from HEC and MOFA Pakistan.

Detailed research plan outlining academic background, proposed research questions, and methodology.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be aligned with SJTU supervisor's lab projects.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential evaluation letters from academic professors.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Printed on official university letterhead with institutional email.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official Chinese physical examination form signed by an authorized physician with hospital stamp.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Completed at an authorized diagnostic center with blood test and chest X-ray reports.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official police character certificate issued within the preceding 6 months.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Obtained from local police service center and attested by MOFA.

required_documents_checklist.specification: IELTS Academic (min 6.0), TOEFL iBT (min 85), or institutional English MOI letter.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: MOI letter signed by university registrar.

required_documents_checklist.specification: High-resolution color scan of passport bio page valid for at least 2 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani passport must have validity through late 2028.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Main intake is Autumn (September). Round 1 (December 15 deadline) is essential for top-tier CSC scholarship consideration.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Undergraduate GPA and performance in core computing and engineering courses)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Quality of research proposal, supervisor acceptance letter, and previous publications/capstone)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of academic intent and justification for SJTU)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 0% (Interview performance factored directly into final ranking)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: SJTU SEIEE Faculty Admissions Board and Graduate School Scholarship Committee.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-phase evaluation: academic credential audit and professor nomination followed by faculty panel interview.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~3,500 to 5,000 international graduate applicants across SJTU
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~200 to 300 fully funded CSC and SJTU fellowships awarded annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~8% to 12% among candidates with professor acceptance letters
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: CGPA 3.50+ / 4.00 from top Pakistani engineering institutions (NUST, FAST, GIKI, UET, NED)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates of accredited computing and engineering faculties with solid programming foundations and practical capstone projects.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani computer science, software engineering, and electronic engineering faculties.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Russia, South Korea, Iran, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Egypt.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of unauthorized agents claiming to sell guaranteed CSC scholarships or SJTU admissions.
Applications are handled exclusively via the official SJTU portal (https://isc.sjtu.edu.cn/) and CSC portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: SJTU application fee is RMB 800 paid directly on the portal; never transfer funds to personal bank accounts.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Shanghai Jiao Tong University does not work with third-party recruitment agencies.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Initial pocket money before first stipend transfer: ~RMB 2,000 (~PKR 78,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You can get CSC without a professor's acceptance letter. Reality: At top C9 universities like SJTU, having a professor's acceptance letter increases your scholarship chances exponentially.
Myth: You must study in Chinese. Reality: SJTU SEIEE offers complete Master's and PhD programs taught and researched 100% in English.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial websites state application deadline is April; SJTU CSC scholarship Round 1 closes strictly on December 15.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain good academic standing and pass the mandatory CSC Annual Scholarship Review each spring.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research attendance in the faculty research lab at Minhang Campus.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress report submitted to the Graduate School and China Scholarship Council.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Part-time work off-campus is strictly restricted under Chinese student visa regulations; campus work-study (勤工助学) permitted with university approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No return obligation; graduates are free to work in China or globally under Chinese work visa (Z-visa) schemes.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bond or repayment obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding cancelled if the student fails annual review, engages in illegal employment, or breaches Chinese law.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from both current and prospective supervisors and the Graduate School.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Master's programs cannot be extended; PhD programs can apply for up to 1-year CSC extension based on exceptional research progress.
